title: I built an open-source Python crypto trading bot — feedback welcome
author: Mysterious-Kale2839
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’m sharing a project I’ve been working on: an open-source cryptocurrency trading bot written in Python.

It includes market analysis, an optional dashboard, a machine-learning model, and optional integrations. **Paper trading is the default**; this is an experimental project, not financial advice or a promise of returns. I haven’t verified live trading, so please don’t use it with real funds without carefully reviewing and testing it yourself.

GitHub: [https://github.com/tomateswager/Bot-IA-Crypto](https://github.com/tomateswager/Bot-IA-Crypto)

I’d appreciate feedback, suggestions, or contributions. If you find the project interesting or useful, a star on GitHub would also mean a lot. Thanks!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: paper by default, good. two things I'd check before trusting the ML part: is the model trained and scored on separate dates, and does the paper fill use the ask or the last trade? on thin alts the second one alone decides whether it looks good.
